content.summary: HSINCHU, Taiwan (AP) — Chipmos Technologies Ltd. (IMOS) on Tuesday reported profit of $5.3 million in its first quarter. content.title: ChipMOS Technologies Reports Decline in October Revenue
content.summary: ChipMOS Technologies (IMOS) has released an update. ChipMOS Technologies, a leading provider of outsourced semiconductor assembly and test services, reported a decline in revenue for October 2024, registering NT$1,784.9 million (US$55.8 million). This reflects a month-over-month decrease of 5.5% and a year-over-year drop of 9.4%, aligning with the company’s earlier predictions of fluctuating market demands for DRAM and NAND flash.
